title: Intermittent packet drops between Dev and QA subnets on switch SW-CORE-01
description: Developers in subnet 10.10.40.0/24 report ping timeouts to services in 10.10.20.0/24. Trunk port Gi1/0/24 shows Native VLAN mismatch error in syslog.
resolution: Aligned native VLAN configuration on trunk interface Gi1/0/24 to VLAN 999. Cleared dynamic MAC address table. Verified 0% packet drop across subnets.

title: VLAN 20 routing failure after scheduled maintenance
description: Following scheduled firmware updates, engineering VLAN 20 is unreachable from the DMZ. Logs report spanning tree port state blocked by loop-guard.
resolution: Re-enabled spanning-tree portfast edge on access ports and corrected trunk encapsulation. Inter-VLAN routing restored.

title: Broadcast storm on Floor 3 access switch causing core packet loss
description: Offices on 3rd floor experiencing network freezing. Switch uplink CRC errors incrementing rapidly due to loop on access port.
resolution: Identified loop caused by unmanaged desktop switch. Enabled BPDU guard on port Gi1/0/12 which auto-disabled offending port. Network stabilized.

title: Engineering laptops receiving 169.254.x.x APIPA addresses on 4th floor
description: Multiple staff arriving on Tuesday morning cannot connect to LAN. Windows reports 'No Internet, secured' with 169.254 address. DHCP server reports 100% scope utilization.
resolution: Shortened DHCP lease time from 7 days to 4 hours on hot-desking scope 10.150.0.0/24. Reclaimed 114 inactive leases. Clients received valid IP addresses.

title: Building B Wi-Fi clients failing to obtain IP address
description: Guests and employees in Building B conference center cannot connect to corporate Wi-Fi. Access points report DHCP DISCOVER timeouts.
resolution: Expanded DHCP scope mask from /24 to /23 (added 254 additional lease addresses). Verified new clients successfully obtain IP within 2 seconds.

title: Internal service endpoints failing to resolve (NXDOMAIN)
description: Applications reporting connection refused to internal-auth.corp.local. DNS query to primary domain controller returns SERVFAIL.
resolution: Restarted DNS server service on DC01 and cleared resolver cache. Verified authoritative forward lookup zone replication completed successfully.

title: DNS recursive forwarder timeout during morning login peak
description: Employees experiencing 30-second delays opening internal intranet and Jira. DNS forwarder queue saturated.
resolution: Configured secondary upstream DNS forwarder IP and cleared stale root hints cache. Query response latency returned to < 5ms.

title: Laptops unable to connect to Corporate-Secure Wi-Fi
description: Staff reporting 'Can\'t connect to this network' on WPA3 enterprise SSID. NPS server logs show EAP-TLS handshake failure code 16.
resolution: Discovered RADIUS server SSL certificate expired at midnight. Renewed certificate on Enterprise CA, rebound in NPS policies, and verified association.

title: MacBook fleet rejecting 802.1X Wi-Fi profile
description: Following macOS update, corporate MacBooks fail 802.1X RADIUS authentication due to untrusted intermediate certificate.
resolution: Pushed updated Intermediate CA bundle via Jamf MDM profile. Laptops successfully authenticated and joined Wi-Fi.

title: SSH sessions and git push freezing on corporate VPN
description: Developers connected to remote VPN experience SSH session freeze immediately after authentication. Small pings work, but large packets drop.
resolution: Diagnosed MTU blackhole on VPN concentrator. Configured 'ip tcp adjust-mss 1360' on tunnel interface. Git pushes and SSH sessions now stable.

title: Large file upload stalling over site-to-site IPsec tunnel
description: Branch office unable to sync 100MB CAD files to headquarters file server. Packets larger than 1420 bytes dropped without ICMP fragmentation response.
resolution: Allowed ICMP Type 3 Code 4 on edge firewall and clamped TCP MSS to 1380. Verified 100MB file transfer completed without stall.

title: External customer emails delayed by 2 hours
description: Customer support agents notice inbound ticket confirmations arriving 90-120 minutes late. Exchange message trace indicates deferred queue status.
resolution: Identified throttling on third-party spam gateway relay IP. Whitelisted transactional sender IP in Exchange Enhanced Filtering. Queue cleared.

title: Inbound billing invoices stuck in pending status
description: Finance team missing time-sensitive vendor invoices. Message headers show 45-minute pause at inbound connector.
resolution: Resolved connector concurrency limit. Re-routed high-priority vendor domain to direct TLS connector. Delay eliminated.

title: Automated Salesforce customer emails rejected with DMARC 550
description: Sales team reports quote notification emails sent from Salesforce are bouncing from customer domains with DMARC 550 5.7.26 policy failure.
resolution: Added include:_spf.salesforce.com to corporate DNS SPF record and configured custom 2048-bit DKIM keys in Salesforce admin portal.

title: Marketing newsletter landing in recipient spam folders
description: HubSpot marketing campaign emails receiving low open rate. DKIM selector DNS check failed due to missing CNAME record.
resolution: Created missing DKIM CNAME records in Cloudflare DNS. Verified DMARC alignment passes at 100% on dmarcian inspector.

title: Outlook crashing on startup with Faulting Application error
description: Executive assistant's Outlook crashes immediately upon launch. Event Viewer shows Event ID 1000 in OUTLOOK.EXE with ntdll.dll module.
resolution: Corrupt 48 GB OST file detected. Renamed outlook.ost to .old and relaunched Outlook in safe mode. Rebuilt clean OST file and enabled 1-year sync slider.

title: Outlook stuck on 'Loading Profile' and disconnected from Exchange
description: User cannot view new emails; status bar permanently reads 'Disconnected'. Safe mode fails to launch profile.
resolution: Cleared credential manager tokens and regenerated local OST data store. Synchronized inbox within 15 minutes.

title: Support team member cannot access tier2-support shared mailbox
description: New hire granted FullAccess to tier2-support shared mailbox, but folder does not appear in Outlook navigation pane after 24 hours.
resolution: Removed stale permission in Exchange Online PowerShell and re-added with AutoMapping set to false. Manually mapped mailbox in Outlook account settings.

title: Shared inbox permissions error: Cannot expand folder
description: Accounting manager receives 'Cannot display the folder. Access denied' when clicking Payroll shared mailbox.
resolution: Re-granted FullAccess and SendAs permissions via Exchange Online PowerShell. Re-cached Address Book in Outlook client.

title: Legitimate vendor contract quarantined by security gateway
description: Legal counsel awaiting multi-million dollar vendor agreement. Email flagged as high-confidence phishing due to password-protected PDF.
resolution: Inspected detonation report in email security console. Verified vendor authenticity and released email with admin override. Whitelisted vendor domain.

title: Quarterly customer invoice blocked by inbound filter
description: Client accounting invoice blocked due to newly registered vendor domain name heuristic rule.
resolution: Manually released invoice from Proofpoint quarantine and added vendor domain to corporate allowlist.

title: Remote engineers cannot connect to US-East VPN Gateway
description: Multiple staff in Virginia unable to connect to GlobalProtect. Client hangs at 'Connecting' and reports Error 504 gateway timeout.
resolution: Identified ISP IPv6 routing degradation affecting primary gateway DNS. Switched GlobalProtect client to secondary IPv4 gateway. Connections restored.

title: VPN connection drops every 15 minutes on home Wi-Fi
description: User experiences frequent VPN tunnel disconnections while working from home. Logs show SSL tunnel renegotiation failure.
resolution: Disabled IPv6 on client Wi-Fi adapter and lowered tunnel MTU to 1360 in GlobalProtect preferences. Connection remained stable for 8 hours.

title: User blocked by Conditional Access from home office (Error 53003)
description: Senior VP travelling for conference cannot log into Office 365. Screen reports 'You cannot access this application from your current location'.
resolution: Reviewed Entra ID sign-in logs. IP was flagged as untrusted foreign territory. Created approved 5-day Named Location exception in Conditional Access.

title: Non-compliant device block after Windows feature update
description: Employee workstation blocked from Teams and Outlook because Intune reported device compliance evaluation failure.
resolution: Triggered manual sync in Intune Company Portal. Verified BitLocker status and OS build number. Compliance restored within 10 minutes.

title: SAML assertion error when logging into Datadog via Okta
description: Engineers clicking Datadog tile in Okta dashboard receive 'SAML Response status code was Responder: InResponseTo invalid'.
resolution: Discovered 4-minute NTP clock skew on identity provider server. Re-synchronized NTP clock on IdP and updated ACS URL in Datadog SAML settings.

title: Single Sign-On failure: Certificate expired error on Jira
description: DevOps team locked out of internal Jira instance. Browser displays SAML signature validation failed.
resolution: Uploaded renewed X.509 signing certificate into Jira SSO configuration and refreshed metadata from Okta.

title: Okta FastPass biometric attestation failing on MacBook Pro
description: Developer cannot authenticate to AWS console using Touch ID. Okta Verify prompts for password loop.
resolution: Cleared corrupted Touch ID biometric enclave registration using bioutil. Re-enrolled fingerprint in macOS settings and re-linked Okta Verify account.

title: Windows Hello PIN not recognized by Okta Verify
description: User receives 'Device trust verification failed' after motherboard replacement on ThinkPad laptop.
resolution: Cleared TPM state via TPM management console, re-enrolled Windows Hello PIN, and completed device re-registration in Okta Verify.

title: DevOps cannot SSH into production Kubernetes bastion
description: SSH connection to bastion.prod.company.com returns Permission denied (publickey). HashiCorp Vault certificate rejected.
resolution: Identified that signed SSH client certificate expired after 12-hour TTL. Re-generated signed certificate via Vault CLI with proper principals.

title: PAM session termination during emergency database patch
description: DBA disconnected from database server mid-maintenance. CyberArk session monitoring flagged idle timeout.
resolution: Re-authenticated to CyberArk PAM portal with emergency change ticket number and resumed administrative session.

title: Developer laptop CPU throttled to 0.79 GHz under load
description: Software engineer reports extreme IDE freezing and compilation taking 45 minutes instead of 2 minutes. CPU clock speed locked at 798 MHz.
resolution: Discovered user was powering 130W Dell Precision laptop with an underpowered 45W monitor USB-C cable. Connected 130W OEM power adapter. CPU clock restored to 3.8 GHz.

title: ThinkPad P16 fan running at 100% with thermal shutdown
description: Laptop powering off abruptly during Docker container builds. HWMonitor shows core temps hitting 100°C.
resolution: Cleaned dust blockage from cooling fins and updated BIOS to version 1.34 which includes updated thermal fan curve tables. Temperatures dropped to 65°C.

title: Dual 4K monitors flickering black every 2 minutes on Dell dock
description: Marketing director reports external screens going black intermittently when connected to WD19TBS Thunderbolt dock.
resolution: Upgraded dock firmware to latest package and disabled 'Panel Self-Refresh' in Intel Graphics Command Center. Replaced generic DP cables with certified DP 1.4 cables.

title: Thunderbolt dock USB keyboard and audio disconnecting
description: Dock loses USB peripheral connections randomly while video continues working.
resolution: Updated Intel Thunderbolt Controller drivers and disabled USB Selective Suspend in Windows Advanced Power Plan.

title: Shipping station Zebra ZT410 printer queue crashing Print Spooler
description: Warehouse packing line halted because shipping labels are not printing. Windows Print Spooler service stops immediately upon start.
resolution: Stopped spooler service, purged corrupted print jobs from C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS, and upgraded to ZDesigner v10 driver. Calibrated label gap.

title: Zebra label printer skipping every second label and printing misaligned
description: Barcode labels printing off-center and feeding blank labels between items.
resolution: Performed manual media sensor calibration via Zebra Setup Utilities and set correct 4x6 label dimension in print preferences.

title: BSOD CRITICAL_PROCESS_DIED and SSD mounted read-only
description: Engineering workstation crashed with BSOD. On reboot, drive is read-only and Windows fails to boot.
resolution: Booted into Linux Live environment. SMART logs showed NVMe spare blocks exhausted (drive entered fail-safe read-only mode). Imaged user data to external drive and replaced SSD.

title: Disk write errors and filesystem corruption on NVMe drive
description: User unable to save files or clone git repos. Event Viewer shows disk error controller nvme0 has error event 11.
resolution: Ran chkdsk /f /r and confirmed hardware controller failure. Replaced NVMe drive under manufacturer warranty and restored user backup.

title: Poly Studio USB video bar not detected in Boardroom Teams Room
description: Executive meeting starting in 10 minutes; Teams Room console reports 'Microphone and Camera Disconnected'.
resolution: Power-cycled the USB-over-CAT6 transmitter and receiver boxes behind boardroom display. Reset USB root hub in Device Manager. Poly Studio detected and functional.

title: Robotic audio and microphone clipping in conference room
description: Remote participants complain of audio distortion during town hall call from Conference Room A.
resolution: Adjusted microphone gain in Poly Lens management utility and disabled acoustic fence boundary conflict. Audio clarity restored.

title: Intune deployment of Cisco Webex failing with Error 1603
description: Company-wide rollout of Webex failing on 40 endpoints with Fatal Error 1603 in Intune Management Extension log.
resolution: Inspected verbose MSI log and found pending reboot flag from previous patch. Added '/norestart /qn' flags and configured prerequisite reboot detection in Intune packaging.

title: Docker Desktop installation aborting on developer laptops
description: MSI installer exits with code 0x80070643 during Hyper-V feature registration.
resolution: Removed leftover registry keys from prior partial install using Microsoft FixIt tool. Installation succeeded.

title: Internal deployment CLI blocked by macOS Gatekeeper
description: Developers on macOS Sequoia cannot run internal 'deploy-tool'. OS prompts 'App cannot be opened because Apple cannot check it for malicious software'.
resolution: Removed quarantine extended attribute via `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine`. Submitted binary to corporate Apple Developer Enterprise account for notarization.

title: macOS reporting internal build tool is damaged and can't be opened
description: Engineers unable to launch proprietary data visualizer app after direct download.
resolution: Cleared quarantine attribute and updated distribution pipeline to sign binaries with developer ID certificate.

title: VS Code Remote SSH host key verification failed for dev EC2
description: Developer cannot connect to cloud dev instance. Terminal reports 'Host key verification failed. Remote host identification has changed!'.
resolution: Confirmed EC2 instance was re-created with new IP address. Removed old fingerprint via `ssh-keygen -R <host-ip>` and re-authenticated successfully.

title: JetBrains Gateway failing to establish remote development session
description: Connection refused during SSH handshake when connecting to remote Linux workstation.
resolution: Updated known_hosts entry and verified user public key was deployed in remote authorized_keys file.

title: npm install failing with SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN on office Wi-Fi
description: Node.js developers unable to install dependencies. npm reports request to registry.npmjs.org failed with self-signed certificate in chain.
resolution: Exported corporate Zscaler root CA certificate and configured npm: `npm config set cafile C:\Certs\CorporateRootCA.crt`. Dependency downloads functional.

title: pip install SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED in Python virtual environment
description: Python developers cannot install packages due to corporate proxy SSL inspection.
resolution: Set global environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE pointing to corporate root certificate bundle. Pip installs succeeded.

title: WSL2 registration failing with error 0x80370102 on Windows 11
description: New developer laptop cannot launch Ubuntu in WSL2. Error states hardware-assisted virtualization is disabled.
resolution: Enabled 'hypervisorlaunchtype auto' via bcdedit and enabled VirtualMachinePlatform Windows feature. Restarted laptop and verified VT-x in BIOS.

title: Docker Desktop fails to start WSL2 engine on workstation
description: Docker reports 'Failed to initialize WSL2 backend: virtualization not enabled'.
resolution: Enabled Virtual Machine Platform in Windows Features and updated WSL kernel via `wsl --update`.

title: Account locking out repeatedly every 60 seconds for HR manager
description: HR manager unlocks account, but it relocks within one minute. PDC logs show BadPwdCount incrementing from internal IP.
resolution: Traced Event ID 4740 on PDC to user's tablet with stale password saved in corporate Wi-Fi profile. Updated saved password on tablet and cleared lockout.

title: Developer account locked out by automated scheduled task
description: Software engineer account locking out at 3:00 AM every night.
resolution: Identified old scheduled batch job running under user credentials with expired password. Updated scheduled task to run under a Managed Service Account (gMSA).

title: Logon failure: System cannot log you on due to clock skew
description: User cannot log into domain computer. Event Viewer logs Kerberos error KRB_AP_ERR_SKEW (Event ID 14).
resolution: Discovered laptop local clock was 8 minutes behind Domain Controller. Re-registered w32time service and executed `w32tm /resync /force`. Kerberos login restored.

title: File share access denied due to Kerberos ticket mismatch
description: Workstation unable to open shared network drives on file server FS01.
resolution: Synchronized system clock with domain NTP source and purged cached Kerberos tickets via `klist purge`.

title: Terraform pipeline failing with AccessDenied on AssumeRole
description: CI/CD deployment fails with error 'User is not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRole on role arn:aws:iam::12345:role/Deployer'.
resolution: Discovered user session token expired. Re-authenticated with AWS SSO CLI and updated role trust policy to permit updated session boundary.

title: AWS CLI reporting ExpiredToken during S3 data migration
description: Data engineer running batch upload encounters token expiration after 1 hour.
resolution: Increased maximum session duration for the IAM role to 4 hours in AWS IAM console. Migration completed without interruption.

title: User unable to reset password via SSPR due to missing SMS code
description: Executive locked out during weekend business trip. SSPR portal does not deliver SMS verification code.
resolution: Conducted identity verification via video call. Issued temporary access pass (TAP) and updated mobile phone number format to E.164 in Entra ID admin center.

title: Microsoft Authenticator prompt not ringing on user phone
description: Employee cannot complete two-factor authentication because MFA phone call drops immediately.
resolution: Issued temporary bypass code and re-registered Microsoft Authenticator push notification method on user's new phone.

title: Terminated contractor still appearing in GitHub Organization
description: HR reported departure of contractor, but user still has access to sensitive source code repositories.
resolution: Discovered Okta SCIM sync was lagging due to expired GitHub PAT token. Manually revoked user SAML identity in GitHub Org Settings and refreshed Okta SCIM token.

title: New engineer missing team repository access after Okta assignment
description: New software engineer assigned to 'Frontend Team' in Okta cannot see GitHub repositories.
resolution: Triggered manual group push synchronization in Okta application settings. User received repository permissions within 5 minutes.

title: PostgreSQL RDS connection pool exhausted during peak billing batch
description: During the 2AM billing job, clients receive 500 Internal Server Error. Backend logs report: Connection pool exhausted (100/100 active connections). Postgres CPU at 95%.
resolution: Terminated locking long-running billing aggregation query via pg_terminate_backend. Increased RDS max_connections and configured PgBouncer pool_size=50. Throughput restored.

title: Database deadlocks causing order processing timeouts
description: E-commerce backend reports deadlock detected in transaction updating inventory table.
resolution: Identified non-deterministic row locking order in batch checkout service. Updated application query to sort IDs before acquiring row locks.

title: MySQL read replica falling 4,000 seconds behind master
description: Reporting dashboards showing stale analytical data. SHOW REPLICA STATUS indicates Seconds_Behind_Master is growing continuously.
resolution: Enabled multi-threaded replica appliers: `SET GLOBAL replica_parallel_workers = 8`. Replica caught up to master within 20 minutes.

title: MySQL replication broken with Error 1062 Duplicate Entry
description: Replica stopped processing transactions after manual insert into reporting database.
resolution: Skipped conflicting GTID transaction using `SET GTID_NEXT` and restarted replica. Configured read_only flag to prevent direct writes on replica.

title: Redis cluster memory 100% full, session writes failing with OOM
description: Web application throws OOM command not allowed when used memory > maxmemory. Users being logged out abruptly.
resolution: Identified unbounded analytics keys stored without TTL. Changed eviction policy to allkeys-lru and flushed unneeded analytics prefix keys. Memory dropped to 65%.

title: Redis latency spike to 500ms due to bigkey serialization
description: Microservices experiencing timeout waiting for Redis cache response.
resolution: Identified single 150MB hash key using `redis-cli --bigkeys`. Refactored application to paginate data and deleted monolithic key.

title: MongoDB replica set has no primary node (NotWritablePrimary)
description: Applications unable to perform database writes. mongosh rs.status() shows all nodes in SECONDARY state.
resolution: Discovered network partition between primary datacenter and witness node. Restored connectivity and forced re-election. Primary elected successfully.

title: MongoDB secondary node stuck in RECOVERING state
description: Node fails to sync oplog after unclean shutdown.
resolution: Resynced secondary node from healthy primary snapshot. Node rejoined replica set and resumed real-time replication.

title: SQL Server Error 1105: TempDB PRIMARY filegroup is full
description: Database transactions failing across all enterprise ERP databases. TempDB disk free space at 0 MB.
resolution: Identified runaway report query performing massive un-indexed Cartesian join. Terminated offending SPID, freed 120 GB, and pre-allocated TempDB with equal file growth.

title: TempDB autogrowth contention causing transaction log pauses
description: Database latency spikes every 30 minutes during autogrowth events.
resolution: Pre-sized TempDB data files to 50 GB each and enabled Instant File Initialization (IFI) in Windows Local Security Policy.

title: Payment service pods CrashLoopBackOff with OOMKilled 137
description: Payment processing microservice pods continuously restarting in production. kubectl describe shows Exit Code 137 OOMKilled.
resolution: Increased container memory limits from 512Mi to 2Gi in Helm deployment values. Diagnosed and fixed unclosed PDF generation stream in application code.

title: Backend worker pods crash during daily batch data import
description: Worker pods killed by Kubernetes killer when processing large CSV files.
resolution: Refactored file processor to stream CSV records instead of reading entire 500MB file into memory buffer. Memory footprint stabilized at 250MB.

title: Java Spring Boot microservice experiencing 6-second GC pauses
description: Prometheus alerts for high p99 latency on checkout service. GC logs report frequent Full GC (Allocation Failure) taking 6,200ms.
resolution: Switched JVM garbage collector to G1GC with `-XX:+UseG1GC -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200`. Heap dumps identified memory leak in session cache, which was refactored with weak references.

title: JVM Metaspace memory exhaustion causing service crash
description: Microservice terminated with java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Metaspace.
resolution: Increased MaxMetaspaceSize to 512m and fixed classloader leak in dynamic proxy generator.

title: Node.js API event loop lag exceeding 2,000ms under load
description: Node.js API servers timing out on HTTP requests despite CPU utilization at only 35%. Prometheus reports extreme event loop lag.
resolution: Identified synchronous crypto.pbkdf2Sync operation on main thread. Replaced with asynchronous crypto.pbkdf2 and scaled container replicas from 2 to 6.

title: Server freezing when processing large JSON export requests
description: Exporting user reports causes all concurrent requests to freeze for 10 seconds.
resolution: Offloaded JSON export generation to background BullMQ worker thread pool. Event loop lag returned to < 10ms.

title: AWS Application Load Balancer returning 504 Gateway Timeouts
description: Customers receive 504 Bad Gateway on checkout during flash sale. ALB metrics show elevated TargetResponseTime exceeding 60 seconds.
resolution: Increased ALB idle timeout to match backend keep-alive timeout and scaled ECS task count from 4 to 16. Optimized bottleneck database query on promo code validation.

title: ALB dropping HTTP connections during container deployment
description: Occasional 502/504 errors reported by monitoring during automated deployments.

title: Nginx Ingress returning 502 Bad Gateway on requests with large JWT tokens

resolution: Added proxy-buffer-size: 128k and proxy-buffers-number: 4 annotations to Kubernetes Ingress resource. Large header requests now complete with 200 OK.

resolution: Restarted DNS server service on DC01 and cleared resolver cache. Verified authoritative forward lookup zone replication completed successfully. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: Terminated contractor still appearing in GitHub Organization (affecting regional office staff)
description: HR reported departure of contractor, but user still has access to sensitive source code repositories. Observed affecting regional office staff. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Discovered Okta SCIM sync was lagging due to expired GitHub PAT token. Manually revoked user SAML identity in GitHub Org Settings and refreshed Okta SCIM token. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: Node.js API event loop lag exceeding 2,000ms under load (intermittent degradation reported)
description: Node.js API servers timing out on HTTP requests despite CPU utilization at only 35%. Prometheus reports extreme event loop lag. Observed intermittent degradation reported. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Identified synchronous crypto.pbkdf2Sync operation on main thread. Replaced with asynchronous crypto.pbkdf2 and scaled container replicas from 2 to 6. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: SQL Server Error 1105: TempDB PRIMARY filegroup is full (on secondary subnet)
description: Database transactions failing across all enterprise ERP databases. TempDB disk free space at 0 MB. Observed on secondary subnet. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Identified runaway report query performing massive un-indexed Cartesian join. Terminated offending SPID, freed 120 GB, and pre-allocated TempDB with equal file growth. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: Legitimate vendor contract quarantined by security gateway (during peak hours)
description: Legal counsel awaiting multi-million dollar vendor agreement. Email flagged as high-confidence phishing due to password-protected PDF. Observed during peak hours. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Inspected detonation report in email security console. Verified vendor authenticity and released email with admin override. Whitelisted vendor domain. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: Robotic audio and microphone clipping in conference room (causing operational delay)
description: Remote participants complain of audio distortion during town hall call from Conference Room A. Observed causing operational delay. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Adjusted microphone gain in Poly Lens management utility and disabled acoustic fence boundary conflict. Audio clarity restored. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: New engineer missing team repository access after Okta assignment (intermittent degradation reported)
description: New software engineer assigned to 'Frontend Team' in Okta cannot see GitHub repositories. Observed intermittent degradation reported. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Triggered manual group push synchronization in Okta application settings. User received repository permissions within 5 minutes. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: Redis latency spike to 500ms due to bigkey serialization (causing operational delay)
description: Microservices experiencing timeout waiting for Redis cache response. Observed causing operational delay. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Identified single 150MB hash key using `redis-cli --bigkeys`. Refactored application to paginate data and deleted monolithic key. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: AWS Application Load Balancer returning 504 Gateway Timeouts (intermittent degradation reported)
description: Customers receive 504 Bad Gateway on checkout during flash sale. ALB metrics show elevated TargetResponseTime exceeding 60 seconds. Observed intermittent degradation reported. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Increased ALB idle timeout to match backend keep-alive timeout and scaled ECS task count from 4 to 16. Optimized bottleneck database query on promo code validation. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: ALB dropping HTTP connections during container deployment (during peak hours)
description: Occasional 502/504 errors reported by monitoring during automated deployments. Observed during peak hours. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Configured deregistation delay (connection draining) to 60 seconds and implemented graceful SIGTERM handling in web application. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: DevOps cannot SSH into production Kubernetes bastion (reported by engineering lead)
description: SSH connection to bastion.prod.company.com returns Permission denied (publickey). HashiCorp Vault certificate rejected. Observed reported by engineering lead. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Identified that signed SSH client certificate expired after 12-hour TTL. Re-generated signed certificate via Vault CLI with proper principals. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: Non-compliant device block after Windows feature update (causing operational delay)
description: Employee workstation blocked from Teams and Outlook because Intune reported device compliance evaluation failure. Observed causing operational delay. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Triggered manual sync in Intune Company Portal. Verified BitLocker status and OS build number. Compliance restored within 10 minutes. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: Database deadlocks causing order processing timeouts (intermittent degradation reported)
description: E-commerce backend reports deadlock detected in transaction updating inventory table. Observed intermittent degradation reported. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Identified non-deterministic row locking order in batch checkout service. Updated application query to sort IDs before acquiring row locks. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: Intune deployment of Cisco Webex failing with Error 1603 (on secondary subnet)
description: Company-wide rollout of Webex failing on 40 endpoints with Fatal Error 1603 in Intune Management Extension log. Observed on secondary subnet. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Inspected verbose MSI log and found pending reboot flag from previous patch. Added '/norestart /qn' flags and configured prerequisite reboot detection in Intune packaging. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: File share access denied due to Kerberos ticket mismatch (reported by engineering lead)
description: Workstation unable to open shared network drives on file server FS01. Observed reported by engineering lead. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Synchronized system clock with domain NTP source and purged cached Kerberos tickets via `klist purge`. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: Payment service pods CrashLoopBackOff with OOMKilled 137 (causing operational delay)
description: Payment processing microservice pods continuously restarting in production. kubectl describe shows Exit Code 137 OOMKilled. Observed causing operational delay. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Increased container memory limits from 512Mi to 2Gi in Helm deployment values. Diagnosed and fixed unclosed PDF generation stream in application code. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: Docker Desktop installation aborting on developer laptops (affecting remote workforce)
description: MSI installer exits with code 0x80070643 during Hyper-V feature registration. Observed affecting remote workforce. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Removed leftover registry keys from prior partial install using Microsoft FixIt tool. Installation succeeded. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: Account locking out repeatedly every 60 seconds for HR manager (causing operational delay)
description: HR manager unlocks account, but it relocks within one minute. PDC logs show BadPwdCount incrementing from internal IP. Observed causing operational delay. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Traced Event ID 4740 on PDC to user's tablet with stale password saved in corporate Wi-Fi profile. Updated saved password on tablet and cleared lockout. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: Laptops unable to connect to Corporate-Secure Wi-Fi (affecting remote workforce)
description: Staff reporting 'Can\'t connect to this network' on WPA3 enterprise SSID. NPS server logs show EAP-TLS handshake failure code 16. Observed affecting remote workforce. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Discovered RADIUS server SSL certificate expired at midnight. Renewed certificate on Enterprise CA, rebound in NPS policies, and verified association. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: User unable to reset password via SSPR due to missing SMS code (affecting regional office staff)
description: Executive locked out during weekend business trip. SSPR portal does not deliver SMS verification code. Observed affecting regional office staff. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Conducted identity verification via video call. Issued temporary access pass (TAP) and updated mobile phone number format to E.164 in Entra ID admin center. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: Payment service pods CrashLoopBackOff with OOMKilled 137 (reported by engineering lead)
description: Payment processing microservice pods continuously restarting in production. kubectl describe shows Exit Code 137 OOMKilled. Observed reported by engineering lead. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Increased container memory limits from 512Mi to 2Gi in Helm deployment values. Diagnosed and fixed unclosed PDF generation stream in application code. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: MySQL read replica falling 4,000 seconds behind master (during peak hours)
description: Reporting dashboards showing stale analytical data. SHOW REPLICA STATUS indicates Seconds_Behind_Master is growing continuously. Observed during peak hours. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Enabled multi-threaded replica appliers: `SET GLOBAL replica_parallel_workers = 8`. Replica caught up to master within 20 minutes. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: VPN connection drops every 15 minutes on home Wi-Fi (during peak hours)
description: User experiences frequent VPN tunnel disconnections while working from home. Logs show SSL tunnel renegotiation failure. Observed during peak hours. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Disabled IPv6 on client Wi-Fi adapter and lowered tunnel MTU to 1360 in GlobalProtect preferences. Connection remained stable for 8 hours. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: External customer emails delayed by 2 hours (after routine patch cycle)
description: Customer support agents notice inbound ticket confirmations arriving 90-120 minutes late. Exchange message trace indicates deferred queue status. Observed after routine patch cycle. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Identified throttling on third-party spam gateway relay IP. Whitelisted transactional sender IP in Exchange Enhanced Filtering. Queue cleared. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: Outlook crashing on startup with Faulting Application error (causing operational delay)
description: Executive assistant's Outlook crashes immediately upon launch. Event Viewer shows Event ID 1000 in OUTLOOK.EXE with ntdll.dll module. Observed causing operational delay. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Corrupt 48 GB OST file detected. Renamed outlook.ost to .old and relaunched Outlook in safe mode. Rebuilt clean OST file and enabled 1-year sync slider. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: PostgreSQL RDS connection pool exhausted during peak billing batch (causing operational delay)
description: During the 2AM billing job, clients receive 500 Internal Server Error. Backend logs report: Connection pool exhausted (100/100 active connections). Postgres CPU at 95%. Observed causing operational delay. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Terminated locking long-running billing aggregation query via pg_terminate_backend. Increased RDS max_connections and configured PgBouncer pool_size=50. Throughput restored. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: WSL2 registration failing with error 0x80370102 on Windows 11 (on secondary subnet)
description: New developer laptop cannot launch Ubuntu in WSL2. Error states hardware-assisted virtualization is disabled. Observed on secondary subnet. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Enabled 'hypervisorlaunchtype auto' via bcdedit and enabled VirtualMachinePlatform Windows feature. Restarted laptop and verified VT-x in BIOS. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: Zebra label printer skipping every second label and printing misaligned (affecting remote workforce)
description: Barcode labels printing off-center and feeding blank labels between items. Observed affecting remote workforce. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Performed manual media sensor calibration via Zebra Setup Utilities and set correct 4x6 label dimension in print preferences. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: VLAN 20 routing failure after scheduled maintenance (reported by engineering lead)
description: Following scheduled firmware updates, engineering VLAN 20 is unreachable from the DMZ. Logs report spanning tree port state blocked by loop-guard. Observed reported by engineering lead. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Re-enabled spanning-tree portfast edge on access ports and corrected trunk encapsulation. Inter-VLAN routing restored. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: Quarterly customer invoice blocked by inbound filter (causing operational delay)
description: Client accounting invoice blocked due to newly registered vendor domain name heuristic rule. Observed causing operational delay. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Manually released invoice from Proofpoint quarantine and added vendor domain to corporate allowlist. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: macOS reporting internal build tool is damaged and can't be opened (causing operational delay)
description: Engineers unable to launch proprietary data visualizer app after direct download. Observed causing operational delay. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Cleared quarantine attribute and updated distribution pipeline to sign binaries with developer ID certificate. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: SAML assertion error when logging into Datadog via Okta (intermittent degradation reported)
description: Engineers clicking Datadog tile in Okta dashboard receive 'SAML Response status code was Responder: InResponseTo invalid'. Observed intermittent degradation reported. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Discovered 4-minute NTP clock skew on identity provider server. Re-synchronized NTP clock on IdP and updated ACS URL in Datadog SAML settings. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: Logon failure: System cannot log you on due to clock skew (affecting remote workforce)
description: User cannot log into domain computer. Event Viewer logs Kerberos error KRB_AP_ERR_SKEW (Event ID 14). Observed affecting remote workforce. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Discovered laptop local clock was 8 minutes behind Domain Controller. Re-registered w32time service and executed `w32tm /resync /force`. Kerberos login restored. Verified fix resolved the issue.

title: Docker Desktop fails to start WSL2 engine on workstation (on secondary subnet)
description: Docker reports 'Failed to initialize WSL2 backend: virtualization not enabled'. Observed on secondary subnet. Impacting standard daily workflows.
resolution: Enabled Virtual Machine Platform in Windows Features and updated WSL kernel via `wsl --update`. Verified fix resolved the issue.
